name: Landar
description: A Sharah woman sits alone in a shadowed booth, her scaled skin catching what little light reaches this corner. She nurses a drink with long, webbed fingers, her eyes distant as if watching something beyond the walls. Old salt crusts the edges of her cloak.

dialogue.emote: glances up, her slitted pupils adjusting to your presence
dialogue.say: You're not here for the quiet, are you? Sit if you want. I've got a story about the [unflooded sea] if you're curious.

dialogue.emote: taps a claw against her cup
dialogue.say: Strange tides out there. Strange things buried in the silt.

unflooded sea.say: I saw someone out there last night. Near the old coral beds. They were burying something in a [mound] of silt. Looked heavy. Looked valuable.

mound.say: A low rise of packed silt, just sitting there like someone wanted it found eventually. Or never found at all. Either way, someone with a [shovel] could [dig] it up. Not me though — I don't dig in other people's graves.

dig.say: Digging's honest work, I suppose. Hard on the back though. You'd need a [shovel] and some strength to get through that packed silt.

shovel.emote: gestures vaguely toward the common room
shovel.say: Jalia sells tools at her shop. Shovels, ropes, the things people need when they go poking around places they shouldn't. Tell her I sent you. Or don't. She doesn't care either way.

keywords.story: Stories cost drinks. But this one I'll give you free — something's buried in the [unflooded sea]. Something someone wanted hidden.

sharah.say: My people came from deeper waters than this. The Unflooded Sea is shallow to us. But it has its secrets all the same.
